Samira Noor: Quick thread for Clearwave QBR prep. Need 30/60/90 token snapshot, a baseline + conservative/upside spend scenario, and any onboarding blockers affecting runway. @Ben can you pull the windows?

Ben Holt: Yep. Pulling hosted + dedicated embed windows now. Any particular anomalies to highlight?

Samira Noor: Call out nightly export spikes and any mass-prompt changes. Also show the embed pilot uplift assumptions.

Ravi Desai: FYI embed pilot runs at 15% of queries currently. Onboarding note: their SSO migration stalled for ~2 weeks which delayed seat activation.

Ben Holt: Raw draft numbers:
```
30d: 12.8M tokens (hosted 11.5M / ded-embed 1.3M)
60d: 25.6M
90d: 39.0M
Run-rate: ~0.43M tokens/day
Forecast baseline (90d): 42-55M tokens
Cost delta vs prior qtr: +8-13%
```

Samira Noor: Can you make three scenarios: conservative (no embed uplift), base (embed conversion to 25%), upside (50% conversion). Show percent variance vs renewal quarter and a procurement stress flag if >15%.

Ben Holt: Will do. Also recommend quick mitigations: 1) add alert on single-day tokens > 2x median, 2) set embed batching=128, 3) quota guard on nightly exports.

Ravi Desai: I can run the batching session and demo quota guard config. Also quantifying onboarding uplift timeline (SSO ETA: 10 days).

cs-bot: QBR template link: https://redwood.company/qbr-templates (use "budget-risk").

Samira Noor: Action items:
- Ben: slides + scenarios by Mon 9am PT (2791300800)
- Ravi: batching demo + onboarding uplift notes by Mon EOD
- Samira: draft exec ask (contingency credit range) by Tue noon

Ben Holt: Uploaded numbers: https://drive.redwood/clearwave/qbr-numbers. Will tag for review.

Samira Noor: Nice work. Keep bullets short for exec summary: snapshot, three scenarios, 3 mitigations, credit ask. Closing thread unless anything else. :thumbsup:
